text:
nina: quick PSA - new starter example "edge-client-quickstart" showed a TS typing regression when built for edge. Generics on our SDK helper are inferred as `any` after the edge bundle. hits onboarding docs.

kevin: ugh. any chance this is the sample tsconfig? or did a recent change to our published d.ts surface impl signatures?

nina: both factors play a part. minimal repro attached below. works fine in node (cjs/esm) but after esbuild/swcrc for edge the consumer gets `any`.

```ts
// sdk/src/helpers.ts
export type Opts<T = unknown> = { ctx?: object; meta?: T }
export function wrap<T>(opts: Opts<T>): { read: () => T }
export function wrap(opts: Opts<any>) { return { read: () => (opts.meta as any) } }

// consumer
const x = wrap({ meta: { userId: 123 } })
// expect x.read() -> { userId: number } but TS shows any when bundled for edge
```

rowan: sounds like the implementation signature (`opts: Opts<any)`) is leaking into the published .d.ts. Edge bundlers + `moduleResolution: bundler` can make TS resolve to the wrong declaration file when there are dual ESM/CJS outputs.

alexa: we've seen this before. quick fixes: 1) publish .d.ts with `declare function` overloads (no implementation exported), 2) change public generic defaults to `unknown`, 3) add an explicit wrapper type so consumers don't rely on cross-module inference.

kevin: i prefer non-breaking minimal fix: ensure our emitted d.ts doesn't include the impl signature. we can mark the.impl as `/** @internal */` and set `stripInternal: true` in the declaration build step. That should force consumers to see only the overloads.

nina: that will stop the leak. meantime, i'll update the example tsconfig to `moduleResolution: node16` in the quickstart and add a note in the README so new users aren't blocked.

ci-bot: created DX-4520: "edge bundler causes generic overload inference to widen to any in examples" assigned to @kevin.

rowan: also adding CI: run `tsc --noEmit` for all examples with both `moduleResolution: bundler` and `node16`. catchers like this should be in examples CI.

kevin: plan:
- add a unit typing test in `packages/sdk/typing-tests/edge-wrap.ts` to assert inference
- update declaration emit to strip internal implementation and only publish `declare` overloads
- short-term: example tsconfig change + README note

alexa: add a small note to devx onboarding about moduleResolution differences and when to prefer node16 for edge-compatible typing.

nina: thanks. i'll hold the example PR until the typings PR lands to avoid breaking the quickstart in the wild. will link DX-4520 once i push the repro.

ci-bot: linked PR #1342 -> DX-4520 (in review).

kevin: PR merged, tests added. if anyone still sees issues, reopen DX-4520 and paste the reproduction + tsconfig. :shipit:
